title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1991-04-03
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX-S 90) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 48KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac8 -> Tagged w/Tag & Rename
source: Front Row OTS, Nakamichi CM-300 w/CP-4 shotgun caps -> Sony TC-D5M

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix/audience recording with crystal‑clear bass and a stellar set highlighted by Touch, The Greatest Story Ever Told and a smoking Truckin’→Smokestack Lightning
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the audio – it’s clear, not overly bright, with plenty of low end and superb stereo separation that captures stage ambience. The performance is described as “wicked good,” featuring standout moments like a sparkly Touch solo, focused runs on Loser, dense The Greatest Story Ever Told, and an inspiring Truckin’→Smokestack Lightning jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and praise both the musical performance and the recording quality, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and detailed AUD source with lots of bass, not too bright; great stereo separation, subtle stage hum adds realism, minimal space issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise first set rounded out by a bonus "Don't Ease" and an explosive second set that builds into a memorable Truckin' → Smokestack Lightning jam, showcasing tight transitions and playful interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple sparkly and focused solos (Touch, Loser, Crazy Fingers) plus playful lead on Truckin'.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey highlighted as particularly playful during the Truckin' jam.
